verdict.rationale: Logseq's export docs say the entire graph can be exported as EDN, JSON, Standard Markdown, OPML, Roam JSON and HTML, and community users confirm the data lives locally and can be backed up with GitHub. Two caveats keep the score down: one user reports Logseq's native Markdown files don't work cleanly in other apps such as Obsidian, and another says the new DB version means data is no longer kept as Markdown files. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that a full export round-trips cleanly into other tools, clarity on export fidelity for the new DB version, and documentation of what full-graph exports preserve or lose (assets, whiteboards, block references).
